bio: In a characterful location down a cobbled street near the Wawel Royal Castle, this attractive restaurant has a distinctive medieval style. The walls are hung with tapestries, with matching seat cushions in place on the white wooden banquettes; downstairs, amongst the brick and stone, there's a more cosy, dimly lit vibe. Dishes like homemade pasta with game sauce fuse hearty flavours with careful technique. Above the restaurant are three richly furnished suites....
